|strategy=By Carl 'Mike' Hardy, Red 32<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/dagobah/light/small/effectiverepairs.html</ref>

This is a really cool card. Heck, any card with a picture of Harrison Ford on it is a cool card (that guy is just the bomb!). It's also neat to see him as [[Han Solo]], performing parallel bar gymnastics in the maintenance bay of the [[Millennium Falcon{{!}}Falcon]], too.

All pictures aside, this card's game text ain't that bad either.

The used portion of this interrupt is pretty cut and dry, but useful. Some guy's playing a numbers deck on you and you're scared as all heck to activate and draw cards... You know what's next... The minute your hand drops below 3 cards, he'll hit you with [[Limited Resources]] and cause you to lose 4 Force... While losing that Force, 3720-1 comes up and you lose the game... Sound familiar? Well, you can play this card, cancel [[Limited Resources]] AND recycle a card back into your Life Force... Not too shabby.

However, the lost portion of this card is where this guy really shines! This thing lets you search you Lost Pile (which in itself can be quite useful!) and pull an Effect, Utinni Effect, Mobile Effect or Immediate Effect directly into your hand! Wow, can you see the uses for this card? I know I can. What with all of the great Effects the Light Side has to offer, it's hard to imagine not using this card. Here are some examples... Did your [[Lightsaber Proficiency]] or Mentallian Savrip get Altered prematurely? Well, get it back and put it right back down again! Did your opponent [[Control (Coruscant){{!}}Control]] your [[Ice Storm]] before it managed to dislocate some of his nasties invading you [[Hoth (location){{!}}Hoth]] haven? Well, watch him quiver in fear when you reach right down there and get it back (especially since he's burned that [[Control (Coruscant){{!}}Control]], and may not have another to save him!). Lets say you opponent has you under [[Your Eyes Can Deceive You]]... You have no clue as to what's in your Lost Pile anymore. Play this little baby and take a look see, then grab yourself an Effect just for grins...

Red 32's Combos:

= Regenerate with one of these Utinni Effects, then play [[Effective Repairs]] to get that regenerator right back... Regenerate again... Repeat as desired!

= I have yet to see anyone play with more than one [[You Are Beaten]]... Watch 'em squirm as you simply grab that 'Fury right back into your hand to use again.

= A tricky end game maneuver. Lose your [[Civil Disorder]] to a Force drain early... Later, when the Dark Side starts to run out of options, get that [[Civil Disorder]] back and drop it on him!
|combos=* [[Effective Repairs]] + [[Death Star Plans]] or [[Rycar's Run]] or [[Kessel Run]] or [[Our Most Desperate Hour]]<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Effective%20Repairs</ref>
* [[Effective Repairs]] + [[Uncontrollable Fury]]
* [[Effective Repairs]] + [[Civil Disorder]]
